items.question: Southenic Electronics’ technicians are on hand 24 hours a day ------- you can be at ease knowing help is always available.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“so”代入题干后为“Southenic Electronics’ technicians are on hand 24 hours a day so you can be at ease knowing help is always available.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（so）。
